text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Eight people assassinated in a cowardly way in province of Blida.
- National Transitional Council examines sectorial budgets.
- Algerian people struggled against French colonial paratroopers 36 years ago for independence.
- Algeria marks 36th anniversary of demonstrations which proved final break with French colonialism.
- Islamic Salvation Front spokesman abroad Anwar Haddam arrested in United States.
- Parties react to draft law shaping political groups.
- Cabinet meeting to examine draft law on parties before it is debated by National Transitional Council.
